mapper.sql: DCLR_SN , CMNT_SN , MBR_SN , PRCS_MBR_SN , PST_SN , DCLR_RSN_CD , DCLR_PRCS_STTS_CD , DCLR_ACTN_CD , DCLR_DTL_CN , PRCS_DT , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT

D.DCLR_SN , D.PST_SN , D.CMNT_SN , COALESCE(P.PST_TTL, C.CMNT_CN) AS TRGT_CN , D.DCLR_RSN_CD , D.MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DCLR S WHERE S.PST_SN <=> D.PST_SN AND S.CMNT_SN <=> D.CMNT_SN) AS DCLR_CNT , D.DCLR_PRCS_STTS_CD , D.DCLR_ACTN_CD , D.REG_DT
LEFT JOIN PST P ON P.PST_SN = D.PST_SN LEFT JOIN CMNT C ON C.CMNT_SN = D.CMNT_SN

/* 자동 대상 판별 : 글은 마지막 이력이 처리자 없는 누적 사유, 댓글은 자동 삭제 이력 뒤 변경 없음 (복구 뒤 재삭제 제외) */ ((D.PST_SN IS NOT NULL AND P.PST_STTS_CD = #{blindCd} AND (SELECT H.MBR_SN IS NULL AND H.CHG_RSN = #{autoBlindRsn} FROM PST_STTS_HSTRY H WHERE H.PST_SN = D.PST_SN ORDER BY H.PST_STTS_HSTRY_SN DESC LIMIT 1) = 1) OR (D.CMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND C.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DCLR_STTS_HSTRY H JOIN DCLR X ON X.DCLR_SN = H.DCLR_SN WHERE X.CMNT_SN = D.CMNT_SN AND H.CHG_RSN = #{autoDeleteRsn} AND C.MDFCN_DT <= H.REG_DT)))
mapper.select:
/* 자동 블라인드 대상 목록 조회 : 대상별 1행 */ SELECT MAX(D.DCLR_SN) AS DCLR_SN , D.PST_SN , D.CMNT_SN , COALESCE(P.PST_TTL, C.CMNT_CN) AS TRGT_CN , T.MBR_SN AS TRGT_MBR_SN , T.MBR_NCNM AS TRGT_MBR_NCNM , COUNT(*) AS DCLR_CNT , SUM(D.DCLR_PRCS_STTS_CD = #{receivedCd}) AS RCPT_DCLR_CNT , MAX(D.REG_DT) AS LAST_REG_DT FROM DCLR D
JOIN MBR T ON T.MBR_SN = COALESCE(P.MBR_SN, C.MBR_SN) WHERE GROUP BY D.PST_SN , D.CMNT_SN , P.PST_TTL , C.CMNT_CN , T.MBR_SN , T.MBR_NCNM ORDER BY MAX(D.DCLR_SN) DESC

/* 자동 블라인드 대상 수 조회 : PageHelper 자동 count 파싱이 이 조건에서 멈춰 직접 작성 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM DCLR D
WHERE GROUP BY D.PST_SN , D.CMNT_SN) A

/* 신고 처리 이력 조회 : 처리자 없음은 시스템 처리 */ SELECT H.DCLR_STTS_HSTRY_SN , H.BFR_STTS_CD , H.AFTR_STTS_CD , H.CHG_RSN , H.MBR_SN AS PRCS_MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM AS PRCS_MBR_NCNM , H.REG_DT FROM DCLR_STTS_HSTRY H LEFT JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = H.MBR_SN WHERE H.DCLR_SN = #{dclrSn} ORDER BY H.DCLR_STTS_HSTRY_SN DESC
